title: Animal Control Facility
project_details: Plans call for converting an existing 6,600 square foot facility, formerly used as a Budweiser vehicle maintenance facility, into an animal control facility. The design includes a more modern ventilation system, 47 kennels, and separate rooms for cats, puppies and kittens.

title: Good Samaritan Regional Health Center Replacement
project_details: Plans call for a 134-bed acute care center. The 382,000square-foot facility will include private patient rooms, advanced nurse care stations and outpatient services

title: Chester County Hospital
project_details: Plans call for a new patient care tower at the Chester County Hospital. It will have four levels above grade with a below-grade procedural platform for surgery and interventional procedures. Phase I will add 48 beds with plans for an additional 24 beds in Phase II.
